title: Ссора у Вики и сломанный реквизит  (The Fight at Vika's and Broken Equipment)

segments.t: Jealous after seeing Igor leave, Max confronts Vika in her apartment and accuses her of having an affair with Igor, infuriating her. Meanwhile at the restaurant, Chef Barinov and Nagiyev get drunk and smash Barani's imported kitchen equipment.
Виктория Сергеевна, вы ради бога извините нас.
Я расстроился, что не смог его купить.
В общем, мы так расстроились, что немножко перебрали.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'Are you out of your mind?' Here checking whether Barinov out of Barinov's mind shows Max looking for the real truth.
'Between you and Igor.' Between the kitchen and the apartment, Barinov gives Max a quick, grounded response. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded.
'Just like I saw with my own eyes.' Adding that just like she saw with her own eyes fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
'Well, what else could I think?' Questioning whether what else could he thinks is how Max tests Barinov's story.

'Max, you are the one who needs a doctor.' Since Max is the one who needs a doctor, Barinov does not waste words on excuses. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.

'So you two were playing doctor?' Vika asks whether Barinov two were playing doctor, refusing to let the point slide. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Виктория Сергеевна, вы ради бога извините нас.
'Viktoriya Sergeyevna, for goodness' Between the kitchen and the plan, Max gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.
'Dima just got upset.' Because Dima just got upset, Barinov treats the matter as settled.
Я расстроился, что не смог его купить.
'I got upset that I could not buy it.' Explaining that she got upset that she could not buy it lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
В общем, мы так расстроились, что немножко перебрали.
'Anyway, we got so upset that we drank a little too much.' Max mentions that anyway they got so upset that they drank a little too much so Barinov sees what is at stake.
'And at yourself.' Over the shift and the work, Barinov answers Max without a second thought.
'Do not stress about it.' Pointing out that do not stress about it gives Barinov a sobering reality check.
'Wonderful, just marvelous.' With the shift and plan in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Виктория Сергеевна, вы ради бога извините нас.
Я расстроился, что не смог его купить.
В общем, мы так расстроились, что немножко перебрали.

That wraps up this scene as max bursts out and accuses Vika of sleeping with Igor, while at the restaurant Chef Barinov and Nagiyev drunkenly apologize after smashing Barani's expensive cooking equipment. Until next time!
